name: news-bulletin
purpose: Clear read at broadcast pace. The baseline: if this regresses, something is broken.

name: named-entities
purpose: Proper nouns, numbers and dates. Threshold is deliberately loose: whisper writes spoken numbers as digits, which scores as an error against a word-for-word reference even when it heard correctly.

name: fast-conversational
purpose: Fast, long sentences with few pauses. Stresses the streaming path, where phrases never end and the window keeps growing.

name: two-speakers
purpose: Voice changes mid-clip, alternating every sentence. Checks that a new speaker does not derail the committed text.
